text:
rachel: Heads-up team, polishing the product launch post now. Need final hero line, one-sentence benchmark blurb, and confirm webinar CTA + HubSpot form. Target publish Tue 10am PT.

diego: Proposed hero: 'Predictable LLM inference for production applications.' Short, defensible.

olivia: Love that. For benchmark blurb: 'In our internal benchmark across open models, Redwood reduced median per-request cost by ~30% at 95th percentile latency targets.' Keep it non-absolute, include method note link.
hq_legal: Quick legal note: drop comparative superlatives like 'best' or 'industry-leading'. Also avoid 'guarantee'. Add short method line: 'see benchmark appendix'.

rachel: Draft CTA mapping: primary button -> Register for live demo (HubSpot form id=90012). Secondary -> Download benchmark guide (auto-email after form). UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=redwood-launch-2026&utm_content=cta-demo

diego: Can ops confirm the form id and that it hooks to 'Launch Webinar 2026' list?

ops-bot: Form 90012 exists and maps to list 'Launch Webinar 2026'. Automation 'send-benchmark-guide' present.

olivia: Adding two short examples under 'When to use': 1) semantic search snippet, 2) embeddings-based rerank. I'll paste snippets.
olivia: ```python
# embeddings rerank example
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='REDACTED')
docs = client.embeddings.create(['doc A','doc B','doc C'])
```

rachel: Design needs hero image by 12pm for the header crop. Diego, can you review the hero line and confirm?
diego: Confirmed. Hero locked.
hq_legal: Legal signoff: OK with hero and benchmark blurb as revised. Include link to test harness in appendix.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: 'Redwood Launch Post Publish' Tue 10:00 PT. Invites to rachel,diego,olivia.

olivia: I'll upload the benchmark appendix and image to the assets folder and drop links in the CMS draft.
rachel: Final checklist for 4pm signoff: hero copy, benchmark blurb, legal appendix link, form wiring + UTM, hero asset upload, CTA HREF verified.

diego: Minor copy nit: replace 'per-request cost' with 'per-token cost' in the blurb.
rachel: Done. I'll push final to CMS at 3:45 and ping for approvals. If anyone sees issues after that, flag here. :rocket:
